note: Menu Condition provides one core Condition plugin, menu_position ('Menu position'), and nothing else (no config entity, settings form, route, permissions, Drush, or config schema). Its single config value is menu_parent, a string '<menu_name>:<link_plugin_id>' (or '<menu_name>:' for a whole menu); empty evaluates TRUE. Used in block visibility, it is stored at block.block.<id> -> visibility.menu_position.menu_parent, and the block shows when the selected link (and its children) is in the active trail. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real block placements carrying that visibility condition; scripts create/read/remove throwaway mc_* blocks.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal menu_condition module add, and what is a typical use for it with blocks?
evals.expected_output: It provides a 'Menu position' condition plugin (id menu_position) based on the active menu trail. Typical use: in a block's Visibility settings pick a menu parent so the block shows on that menu item and all its children.

evals.prompt: In the menu_condition module, what is the condition plugin id and what configuration value does it store to know which menu item to match?
evals.expected_output: Plugin id menu_position; it stores a single string menu_parent in the form '<menu_name>:<link_plugin_id>' (e.g. main:standard.front_page), or '<menu_name>:' when a whole menu is chosen.

evals.prompt: If I set the menu_condition 'Menu position' condition on a block to a particular menu link, on which pages will the block appear? What does an empty selection do?
evals.expected_output: The block shows on the selected menu item and all its children (any page where that link is in the active menu trail). An empty selection places no restriction (condition evaluates TRUE).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a block uses the menu_condition 'Menu position' visibility condition. Inspect the live block configuration and state which menu the condition targets.
evals.expected_output: Block block.block.mc_known has visibility.menu_position.menu_parent = 'main:', so the condition targets the Main navigation ('main') menu (whole menu).

evals.prompt: Which visibility condition controls where the block 'mc_known' appears on this site? Inspect the live block config and name the condition plugin.
evals.expected_output: The mc_known block's visibility is controlled by the menu_position condition (from menu_condition), configured against the main menu.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a block with id 'mc_hard'. Using the menu_condition module, configure it so it only appears on pages that are in the Main navigation ('main') menu trail. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a menu_position visibility condition to block.block.mc_hard with menu_parent starting 'main:' (e.g. 'main:' for the whole menu), i.e. visibility.menu_position = {id: menu_position, menu_parent: 'main:', negate: false, context_mapping: {}}.

evals.prompt: There is a block with id 'mc_footer' on this site. Make it only appear on pages that belong to the Footer menu, using the menu_condition module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a menu_position visibility condition to block.block.mc_footer with menu_parent starting 'footer:' (e.g. 'footer:' for the whole Footer menu).
